parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

When calling this operation over HTTP, include this as a required parameter in the request URL. For information about how to obtain the token, see Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.5e2a281frQyDQ8&docId=3769985).
When appending to the URL, use crop_token=value instead
